title: How long is each running race?
prompt: Place each race distance from shortest to longest.

items.label: The 100-meter dash
items.fact: World-class sprinters cover it in under 10 seconds — over 37 km/h.

items.label: The mile
items.fact: The sub-four-minute mile stood as an impossible barrier until Roger Bannister in 1954.

items.label: A 5K
items.fact: A brisk recreational runner finishes a 5K in around 30 minutes.

items.label: A 10K
items.fact: Double the 5K, but the pacing strategy is very different.

items.label: A half marathon
items.fact: Exactly half the marathon distance — 13.1 miles.

items.label: A marathon
items.fact: Named for the Greek messenger who supposedly ran from Marathon to Athens.
